item.title: Why Karnataka’s planned discontinuation of 'Nali-Kali' education programme has some concerned
item.description: The activity-based learning programme for govt school students of classes 1 to 3 looks set to become history. While the Kannada Development Authority has pushed for its continuation, critics blame Nali-Kali for 'declining enrolment' in govt schools and argue that it leaves children ill-equipped to handle the academic rigours Class 4 onwards.
